assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmias
The telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
Coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
Proof of primary payment or a denial from the primary carrier is requested
